sloka: एवं मधुरमुक्तस्तु गुरुणा राघव: स्वयम् ।प्रत्युवाच समासीनं वसिष्ठं पुरुषर्षभ: ॥ २.१११.८॥
transliteration: evaṁ madhuramuktastu guruṇā rāghava: svayam ।pratyuvāca samāsīnaṁ vasiṣṭhaṁ puruṣarṣabha: ॥ 2.111.8॥

translations.english: When Rama, the best of men, was advised personally by Vasistha, the preceptor, with sweet words, he replied to him who was sitting beside him:
